questions.q: A heat exchanger has a design rating based on a working pressure of 7 bar g. What would be the effect of supplying the exchanger with steam at 3 bar g?
options: The heat output would be greater because the enthalpy of evaporation at 3 bar g is higher than at 7 bar g.
The heat output would be greater because steam at 3 bar g has a greater volume than steam at 7 bar g.
Less weight of steam would be required because steam at 3 bar g has a higher enthalpy of evaporation than 7 bar g.
The output would be reduced because the difference in temperature between the steam and product is reduced.
questions.answer: The output would be reduced because the difference in temperature between the steam and product is reduced.
